name: Textile Designer AI
original_description: Textile Designer AI brings the design tools of your Textile Designer AI account into ChatGPT. Share a print, a garment photo or a sketch, and ChatGPT runs the right tool on it: make a design print ready for a chosen DPI, turn it into a seamless repeat, extract a flat print from a garment photo, generate colourways, separate colours into layered PSD files, vectorize artwork, or create new designs from an image and a description. Results appear as previews and download links in the chat and are saved to your Textile Designer AI library. Sign in with your existing Textile Designer AI account; runs use your organisation's credits.
